references.role: palette and painted object family reference

items.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. ONE standalone source illustration for Mochi Mayhem Power menu, NOT an atlas or a screen. Reference images are STYLE REFERENCES ONLY: existing Power56/57 painted objects; do not reproduce their sheets or layouts. Match their softly raised hand-painted forms, matte candy/crystal materials, thin dark brown/plum contours, warm pale-gold beveled edges, gentle warm highlights and soft internal plum shadows, cream parchment, rose/lavender/mint/turquoise accents. Charming polished confectionery fantasy, slight 3/4 overhead view, clear mobile silhouette, restrained detail. No photorealism, no flat vector glyph, no thick black outline, no shiny plastic3D. TRUE TRANSPARENT RGBA background with no baked matte or checkerboard. NO text, letters, numbers, logos, watermark, square outer frame, interface panel, floor, scenery, cast ground shadow or glow cloud. All objects complete and safely inside edges with generous transparent margins. All implements are friendly blunt pastry/crafting tools, never a sharp weapon. LANDSCAPE composition, target768x384 (aspect2:1). Entire object group confined to the RIGHT HALF of the canvas; LEFT HALF completely empty transparent negative space for later text overlay. Compact attractive tableau, object group visually coherent and balanced in right half, no strands/rays/props reaching into left half. No text is drawn. The translucent placement will be controlled later by game code, so preserve clean painted object opacity. Subject: one SMALL DELICATE LOOM / thread-weaving stand, warm wood and pale golden fittings. Three faceted core jewels floating above it, exactly one rose-pink, one orange-amber, one turquoise-blue. Fine GOLD THREADS connect the three jewels and weave through the little loom. Simple compact triangular arrangement, a little cream-gold spool near base, no written cloth or banners. The three-colored cores and weaving threads dominate, restrained few highlights.
